offering_description.value: The company offers sports betting, online casino gaming, raffles, competitions and loyalty subscriptions to consumers. It also distributes gaming content for businesses and runs its gaming operations online and in betting shops using proprietary technology.

quotes.quote: All our brands, Meridianbet, Expanse Studios, R Kings Competitions, Classics For A Cause, GM-AG, and MexPlay are supported by a scalable proprietary tech platform tailored for every regulated market worldwide. From B2C to B2B and from street-level retail shops to premium online offers, it is all under one roof.

Built on a foundation of proprietary technology and strategic acquisitions, the company operates the full stack of the gaming business, spanning sportsbook, online casino, raffles and competitions across more than 25 international markets.

We operate a complete iGaming ecosystem across B2B and B2C sectors. Every second, our proprietary products are live on 30+ worldwide web destinations and throughout our multiple bricks-and-mortar locations.

From street-level retail betting shops to premium online gaming experiences, Meridian Holdings brings every element of the gaming ecosystem under one roof, positioning the company as a vertically integrated iGaming powerhouse delivering technology, content and operations at global scale.
